# Maroski — Seeing Through Solid Words (2025)

## Chicago 18 forms

**Full note:** Lisa Maroski, “Seeing Through Solid Words: Using Gebser’s Concept of Transparency to Understand a Gnostic Poem Expressing Integral Consciousness,” *Journal of Conscious Evolution* 21, no. 1 (2025): 1, https://digitalcommons.ciis.edu/cejournal/vol21/iss1/5/.

**Shortened note:** Maroski, “Seeing Through Solid Words,” 1.

**Bibliography:** Maroski, Lisa. “Seeing Through Solid Words: Using Gebser’s Concept of Transparency to Understand a Gnostic Poem Expressing Integral Consciousness.” *Journal of Conscious Evolution* 21, no. 1 (2025). https://digitalcommons.ciis.edu/cejournal/vol21/iss1/5/.

## Essay use

Maroski provides a scholarly secondary carrier for a narrow account of Gebserian transparency as form rather than content, and for the non-successive relation among consciousness structures. It supports §0/1 #4's methodological transition and qualifies any fusionist reading.

**Claim boundary:** it does not establish QL/MEF, a view from nowhere, or an identity of mathematics, phenomenology, psychology, myth, and design. Direct quotation from Gebser awaits a licensed primary edition.
